name: – Andrzej Halicki – After § 21 – Am 80
title: REPORT on general guidelines for the preparation of the 2026 budget, Section III – Commission
part_text: 21b. Calls on the Commission to increase and sustain funding for the United Nations Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees, recognising the Agency’s crucial role in delivering essential services to an increasingly vulnerable population in the Middle East and ensuring the uninterrupted provision of humanitarian assistance;
